summary: Frontend-only test on the web preview at 390x844 with app_language='de'. The welcome dialog was accepted. All 6 requested flows PASS. One HIGH sync bug and two minor issues were found. (1) Tapping 'Eigene Zeit' (apt-remind--1) opens dt-sheet titled 'Wann soll ich dich erinnern?' with the default value = appointment time - 60 min (04.11.2026 09:00). The quick buttons dt-quick-0/1/2 set Heute/Morgen/Übermorgen. Each of 'abc', '32.13.2026 25:99' and '31.02.2027 10:00' shows the 'Ungültige Zeit' alert. '01.01.2020 08:00' shows the 'Zeit liegt in der Vergangenheit' alert. dt-cancel closes the sheet and the chip keeps 'Eigene Zeit'. Confirming '20.12.2026 07:45' closes the sheet and the chip shows '20.12.2026 07:45'. (2) apt-travel--1 'Abfahrt wählen' opens the sheet titled 'Wann willst du losfahren?'. After confirming, the chip shows 'Los: 21.12.2026 06:30'. Saving persists remind_before=-1/remind_at and travel_minutes=-1/depart_at. On reopen ('Termin bearbeiten') both chips and the sheet inputs are restored. Switching to 15 Min clears depart_at and shows the departure info 09:35. (3) apt-remind-30 and apt-travel-15 without an appointment time each show the 'Uhrzeit fehlt' alert. (4) /customers?selectMode=true (opened via Neues Projekt -> 'Kunde auswählen...') shows exactly ONE header 'Kunde auswählen' with a back arrow, and customers-back returns to /projects/new. /customers shows one 'Startseite' header. (5) /projects/<id> project-appointment 'Termin planen' opens the 'Neuer Termin' modal with the project chip preselected, title = project name, the customer chip set and the address prefilled. Saving shows the chip project-appointment-<id> 'Mi., 04.11.26, 09:30 Uhr' with a bell icon, and the button changes to 'Weiteren Termin planen'. Tapping the chip opens 'Termin bearbeiten', and changing the time to 11:15 is reflected in the chip and in project.appointment_date/time. Home 'Nächste 7 Tage' and the /appointments calendar each show exactly one entry. Deleting the appointment in the project removes the chip and clears project.appointment_date. (6) Regression: 'Aus Kunden' fills the title and address. apt-create-project opens /projects/new with the customer, Straße/PLZ/Ort and the description prefilled. BUG (HIGH): the project.appointment_date sync only runs inside ProjectAppointment. If a project-linked appointment is moved or deleted from Home or /appointments, a stale or duplicate 'ghost' project entry appears. BUG (MEDIUM): 'Termin planen' prefills the customer's home address instead of the project Objektadresse (objekt_street/plz/city). MINOR: a custom reminder or departure time later than the appointment itself is accepted. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: REPRODUCED: Create an appointment from a project (Morgen 09:30). Then, on Home, edit it and move it to Übermorgen. Home now shows 2 entries: home-week-p-proj_TEST_1 (stale project appointment 04.11 09:30) AND home-week-a-<id> (05.11). After deleting the appointment on Home, the ghost entry home-week-p-proj_TEST_1 remains. The project page then shows project-appointment-legacy 'Termin Mi., 04.11.26, 09:30 Uhr'.

The project 'TEST_Dach Berger' has the Objektadresse 'Baustellenweg 3, 80999 München', but 'Termin planen' prefilled the customer's address 'Lindenweg 7, 80331 München'. projectAddress(p, c) only uses p.address (not set by /projects/new) and then falls back to the customer address, ignoring objekt_street/objekt_plz/objekt_city. The same function feeds the agenda Navi address. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/home/AppointmentFormModal.tsx:23

remind_at/depart_at later than the appointment start is accepted (appointment 04.11.2026 10:00 saved with remind_at 20.12.2026 07:45 and depart_at 21.12.2026 06:30). A reminder after the appointment is useless. Reference: AppointmentFormModal.tsx:176

issues: Pressing a quick button (Heute/Morgen/Übermorgen) after typing a time in dt-input overwrites the typed time with the previous time (quick() is based on temp, not on the typed text). Minor.

action_items: HIGH: Move the project.appointment_date/time sync (next upcoming linked appointment, or null) out of ProjectAppointment.afterSave and into AppointmentService.save/remove, or call it from every onSaved (app/index.tsx and app/appointments.tsx). Also consider deduping in buildAgenda (src/utils/agenda.ts): hide the project item whenever any linked appointment exists for that project, not only one on the same date.
MEDIUM: projectAddress() should prefer the project Objektadresse: generateFullAddress(p.objekt_street, p.objekt_plz, p.objekt_city) before p.address and the customer address.
LOW: Reject a custom remind_at/depart_at that is later than the appointment start (or warn about it).
LOW: In DateTimeSheet.quick() on web, keep the time the user has typed (parse the text first).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectAppointment loads customers asynchronously. If the modal is opened before the load finishes, the address prefill stays empty, because the AppointmentFormModal init effect does not depend on `customers`.
ProjectAppointment passes projects={[project]}, so 'Ohne Projekt' unlinks the appointment and it then vanishes from the project. This is acceptable but may surprise users.
app/projects/[id].tsx is 6128 lines and app/customers/index.tsx is 1841 lines. Both should be split.
No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) were found.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all 6 requested flows pass; 1 high + 1 medium + 2 low issues found in adjacent flows)

seed_data_creation: Each run used a fresh browser context with localStorage seeded with customer cust_TEST_1 'Lena TEST_Berger' and project proj_TEST_1 'TEST_Dach Berger'. Nothing was persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts with empty localStorage. Seed via page.evaluate, then reload, then wait up to 10s for the welcome checkbox text (it can appear late). Storage keys: aufmassprofi_appointments / aufmassprofi_projects / aufmassprofi_customers. Home row testIDs: home-week-a-<aptId> (appointment) and home-week-p-<projectId> (project appointment). The browser date was 2026-11-03 (UTC).
rca_of_issue: Ghost/duplicate entries: buildAgenda adds a project item whenever project.appointment_date is set and no linked appointment exists on that same date. project.appointment_date is only updated in ProjectAppointment.afterSave (and in /projects/new from_appointment). Editing or deleting the linked appointment from Home or /appointments goes through AppointmentFormModal.onSaved, which never updates the project, so the stale date stays. Repro: project -> Termin planen (Morgen 09:30) -> save -> Home -> tap the appointment -> Übermorgen -> save => 2 entries; delete => ghost remains. Mitigation: centralise the sync in AppointmentService.
